metadata.sql: SELECT AVG(T1.balance) FROM trans AS T1 JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id JOIN district AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id JOIN disp AS T4 ON T2.account_id = T4.account_id JOIN card AS T5 ON T4.disp_id = T5.disp_id WHERE T3.region = 'South Bohemia' AND T5.type = 'junior' AND T5.issued > '1997-12-31'
metadata.evidence: Evidence: 'Good loan status' is defined as status IN ('A', 'B') where contracts finished or running OK; 'Defaulted loan' is defined as status IN ('C', 'D'). Operation 'VYBER' denotes cash withdrawal.

metadata.sql: SELECT count(T1.loan_id) FROM loan AS T1 JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id JOIN district AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id WHERE T3.unemp_96 > 5.0
